title: Support legacy clients
excerpt: Support legacy clients A legacy client speaks a 2025 era protocol revision: it opens with initialize and sends no per request meta envelope. Both serving entry points answer those clients from the same factory that serves modern ones; the legacy option decides whether they keep doing it. Protocol versions covers the era model itself.
